title: Validated authorization bypass in local demo route

observedFacts.claim: The local demo route accepts an ownerId parameter from the request body.
A regression test shows a non-owner can access another owner's record before the patch.

inferences: The authorization decision trusts attacker-controlled ownerId.
violatedInvariant: Record access must be authorized against the authenticated subject, not request-supplied ownership.
trustBoundary: HTTP request body to server-side authorization check.
attackerControl: The attacker controls ownerId in the request body.
exploitPreconditions: Authenticated non-owner account in the local demo app.
impact: A non-owner can read another user's local demo record.
reproductionSteps: Send a request containing user B's ownerId.
Observe user B's record in the response.
counterevidence: This is sample data and not a real target report.
